description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, which is an Android Fragment that contains a custom LogView for displaying log data. It handles the creation and configuration of UI components such as ScrollView and LogView, manages text change events to automatically scroll, and provides access to the LogView instance.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that hosts a LogView within a ScrollView, allowing log messages to be displayed and scrolled automatically.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Sets up the ScrollView and LogView, configures layout parameters, padding, font, and appearance, and returns the ScrollView containing the LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the view hierarchy, adds a TextWatcher to automatically scroll to the bottom when log content changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying LogView instance.
